purpose: Teach: 趣向/営み/勤める/試聴/範疇/本位/比重/集英社

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、新商品に趣向を凝らされたぞ
lines.en: Dad — when you were founding the company, you were so thoughtful about every new product.
lines.style: Quiet, measured respect. Slow cadence. Each phrase lands like a deliberate remembrance. Warm underneath — the pride of recalling someone's choices.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員の営みを大切にされた
lines.en: Yes. Dad always cared deeply about the lives of our staff.
lines.style: Steady, composed. Not rushing to fill the space. Speaking as witness to the same memory. Quiet conviction — this matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、長く勤める社員を表彰されたぞ
lines.en: Dad — you recognised the loyalty of people who stayed with you. You honoured that.
lines.style: Softer now, tinged with gentle sadness. Slower pace. The voice of someone reaching back to touch a specific moment. Small smile in the tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは試聴会のような場を社員に与えられた
lines.en: Yes. Dad gave our staff moments to come together, to listen and be heard.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost turning something over in his mind as he speaks. Not reciting — remembering. Quiet and steady, the way one speaks of someone irreplaceable.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、自分の範疇を弁えて経営されたぞ
lines.en: Dad — you understood your own limits as a leader. You never overstepped them.
lines.style: Voice softens with admiration. Deliberate pace. Each word carries the weight of a son understanding his father's restraint as strength, not limitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはお客様本位を貫かれた
lines.en: Yes. Dad never wavered from putting the customer first.
lines.style: Clear and grounded. A statement of fact, but spoken with quiet pride. Not boastful — the voice of someone who watched this principle hold steady through everything.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、主力事業の比重を時代に応じて変えられたぞ
lines.en: Dad — you adapted what your business focused on, decade after decade. You stayed awake to change.
lines.style: Slower, weighted with appreciation. The voice finds depth — this wasn't luck, it was wisdom. Trailing slightly on the final thought, like a door closing gently.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは集英社的な大手出版社とも提携された
lines.en: Yes. Dad partnered with the great publishers — even the biggest names like Shueisha. He never needed to do that alone.
lines.style: Closing register: grounded, clear, a touch lighter. The voice of someone who understands this was the right thing. Settles on the final image — content, complete.
